metadata.description: Personal Agent Skills by vdsmon, packaged as a plugin marketplace. Each skill ships as its own plugin so you can pick and choose. Plugins prefixed with cc- are Claude-Code-specific (hooks, dynamic context injection, or ${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}), and unprefixed plugins port cleanly to other SKILL.md-native hosts (OpenAI Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Goose, Copilot, etc.).

plugins.name: slack-draft
plugins.description: Draft a Slack message for the user to send: Slack mrkdwn, lead-with-conclusion, backticked identifiers and domain values, ASCII punctuation. Defaults to English and a plain high-level register; pass --tech for a code-reading peer. Draft only, never posts. Portable across SKILL.md-native hosts.

plugins.name: skill-polish
plugins.description: Post-mortem for any skill: finds friction in a session, traces it to the responsible skill file, and edits that file's source checkout, not the plugin install copy. Portable across SKILL.md-native hosts.

plugins.name: cc-cache-keepalive
plugins.description: Keeps Claude Code's prompt cache warm on Max plans with an opt-in silent cron, and cancels any tick that a recent real turn or an already-expired cache makes pointless. Claude Code only.

plugins.name: cc-usage-guard
plugins.description: Pauses Claude Code before it hits the 5-hour or weekly usage limit and auto-resumes when the window resets, on every surface including the desktop app. Claude Code only.

plugins.name: prep-compact
plugins.description: Audit in-flight session state before compaction truncates history, and save what would be lost. Commits real work locally, syncs stale plan and state files, and notes chat-only decisions, asking first only for risky items, then prints a paste-ready /compact message plus a queued follow-up. Portable across SKILL.md-native hosts.

plugins.name: prep-exit
plugins.description: Save what only the conversation knows before a session ends, so a fresh session can pick up the work. Commits real work locally, syncs state files, writes a handoff note and a memory pointer, asks once only for risky items, and prints a paste-ready resume prompt. Portable across SKILL.md-native hosts.

plugins.name: prep-goal
plugins.description: Interrogate a rough objective into a tight, verifiable /goal completion condition before handing it to an autonomous goal loop. Pins the end-state, a gate whose raw output the loop pastes, a scope fence, the forbidden cheat, and a turn cap. Portable across SKILL.md-native hosts.

plugins.name: humanize
plugins.description: Strip AI-writing tells from text. Detects em-dash overuse, AI vocabulary, inflated significance, rule-of-three, sycophancy, compound coinages, and 20+ more patterns. `--casual` also adds the small inconsistencies real writers have. Outputs only the corrected text; files are edited in place. Portable across SKILL.md-native hosts.

plugins.name: brainstorming
plugins.description: Design-before-code gate that sizes each request as a spike, a bounded change, or architectural work, and gets approval on a design before any code. Only architectural work gets a written spec and a planning handoff. Portable across SKILL.md-native hosts.

plugins.name: systematic-debugging
plugins.description: Four-phase debugging discipline (root-cause investigation, pattern analysis, hypothesis, single-fix implementation). No fixes before investigation; 3+ failed fixes means stop and question the architecture. For bugs in code you can run. Portable across SKILL.md-native hosts.

plugins.name: skill-smith
plugins.description: Forge for Agent Skills: create, test, evaluate, optimize triggering, and package skills. Merges an empirical eval loop (run with-skill vs baseline, benchmark, iterate) with TDD-for-skills discipline (baseline-test first, close rationalization loopholes, verify before shipping). Use whenever building a skill from scratch, turning a workflow into a skill, improving or debugging an existing skill, running evals/benchmarks, or raising a skill's triggering accuracy. Portable across SKILL.md-native hosts.

plugins.name: git-cleanup
plugins.description: Clean up stale git branches and worktrees. Finds branches merged into dev/develop/master/main (squash-merge aware on GitHub remotes via gh PR state), checks worktrees for uncommitted changes, and removes what's safe while skipping dirty worktrees. Use for 'clean up branches', 'git housekeeping', 'remove merged branches', 'clean worktrees'. Portable across SKILL.md-native hosts.

plugins.name: strip-migration-cruft
plugins.description: Scan a repo for transitional / migration / phase / wave / story / legacy-alias cruft comments that document past project history rather than current behavior, bucket hits into safe-to-strip vs keep-semantic, then propose surgical edits and execute after confirmation. Use for 'scan for migration comments', 'remove phase/wave/story refs', 'strip transitional cruft', or fatigue with project-history breadcrumbs in code and docs. Portable across SKILL.md-native hosts.

plugins.name: grilling
plugins.description: Relentless one-question-at-a-time interview that stress-tests a plan or design to convergence: facts get looked up in the codebase, decisions go to the human, and nothing is enacted until shared understanding is confirmed. Bundles grilling (the engine), grill-with-docs (grill + write ADRs and a glossary as you go), and domain-modeling (sharpen a ubiquitous language, CONTEXT.md glossary, sparing ADRs). Portable across SKILL.md-native hosts.

plugins.name: teach
plugins.description: Stateful, multi-session teaching workspace: grounds every lesson in a MISSION.md, gathers trusted RESOURCES.md, produces short self-contained HTML lessons in the learner's zone of proximal development, tracks progress via learning-records, and builds storage strength through retrieval, spacing, and interleaving. Portable across SKILL.md-native hosts.

plugins.name: codebase-design
plugins.description: Shared vocabulary for designing deep modules: a lot of behaviour behind a small interface, placed at a clean seam, testable through that interface. Precise glossary (module, interface, implementation, depth, seam, adapter, leverage, locality), the deletion test, the one-adapter-vs-two seam rule, and testability checks. Bundles DEEPENING.md and DESIGN-IT-TWICE.md. Portable across SKILL.md-native hosts.

plugins.name: question
plugins.description: Answer a genuine question in full, with no edits and no side effects. Treats 'why X and not Y?' as curiosity, not as a hidden request to switch to Y or an attack on X. Investigates read-only, explains the tradeoff, gives an honest verdict, and stops. Portable across SKILL.md-native hosts.
